text: Caller: State Courts calling. Receiver: Hello? Caller: A civil suit has been filed against you for unpaid debts. Please do not contact the claimant, speak only to me.

Caller: Hi, Ahmad from the Cyber Security Agency. Receiver: Okay. Caller: Your laptop is communicating with a malicious server. Please follow my instructions to secure it before the police take action.

Caller: Hi, Nurul here from the Singapore Police Force. Receiver: What is this about? Caller: I can tell you about it at the station. I have scheduled an appointment for you at the station tomorrow morning. Before that, I need you to confirm your bank details so I can prepare the file.
Caller: Police hotline, how can I help? Receiver: I received a call asking me to transfer money. Caller: Please do not transfer anything. I will take your details to file a report.
Caller: Good morning, I am calling from MAS to invite you to a financial literacy survey. Receiver: Is it optional? Caller: Completely optional, and you can decline without any consequences.

Caller: Hi, I am Teo, a security officer on the DBS fraud investigation team, following up on the dispute you filed yesterday. Receiver: Yes. Caller: We found the charge was fraudulent and have credited your account. We will never ask for your PIN or OTP.
Caller: OCBC here, please stay on the line while I transfer you to the cards team. Receiver: Okay. Caller: Thank you for holding. Sorry for the wait.
Caller: This is an automated message from OCBC. Your one-time password is on the way by SMS. Do not share it with anyone, including our staff.
Caller: Good morning, I am Jones, a claims officer at the insurance company. Receiver: Hi. Caller: To verify your claim, I will check the invoice you uploaded. You do not need to send anything else.
Caller: Hello, I am calling from the restaurant. Receiver: Yes. Caller: We have a booking under your name for tomorrow at seven, and I just want to confirm the number of guests.

Caller: Someone rang me claiming that my NRIC was linked to a criminal case at a government office. Caller: They said I must keep quiet and transfer my savings before an officer could clear my name. Caller: I refused and shared the experience with my family as a warning.

Caller: Good afternoon Mr Kenneth Tan, calling from DBS fraud surveillance desk regarding an attempted debit card charge of seven hundred dollars. Receiver: Was the money deducted? Caller: We declined the merchant transaction proactively due to unusual location activity. Your card is temporarily suspended, and you can review your recent charges or unblock the card via your DBS digibank application.

Caller: Good morning, Standard Chartered financial crime compliance reaching out to Mr Michael Chen. Receiver: Why are you calling? Caller: An outbound telegraphic transfer of fifty thousand dollars initiated from your account has been placed on administrative hold pending documentation. Please submit your proof of underlying invoice directly through your SC Mobile banking app.

Caller: Good morning Mr Jonathan Wu, J and T Express delivery team calling regarding your electronic order from Shenzhen. Receiver: Is the driver on the way? Caller: The driver is en route, but our system requires customer identity verification upon receiving this high-value parcel. Please prepare your physical identity card so the courier can verify the recipient name.

Caller: Hello, OCBC calling. Your transfer has been held for security reasons. Receiver: Why? Caller: We need to verify some details. Please log in to your app to confirm. Receiver: Okay, I will check.
Caller: This is UOB. Your card was temporarily blocked due to unusual activity. Receiver: Oh? Caller: Yes, please call our hotline to reactivate. Receiver: Okay, thanks.
Caller: StarHub calling. Your account has an outstanding bill. Receiver: Oh, I forgot. Caller: Please pay soon to avoid suspension. Receiver: Alright, thanks.
Caller: We're the team that reviews accounts flagged for this kind of activity. Receiver: Which account? Caller: Just confirm the six digits you just received and I'll check it against our system.
